title: Book Two · Chapter 52: Mum's Two Piles
story:
On Wednesday afternoon, two piles of clothes stand beside Mum's chair. Ronan puts his bag under the table. He reaches for a shirt from the smaller pile.

“Can I take these upstairs?”

“Not yet,” Mum says. “Those still need work.”

The shirt has a loose button. Ronan puts it down again. He looks at the other pile. A small paper rests on top.

“Those are ready?”

“Yes. Keep the paper with them.”

Mum's own blue skirt hangs by the window. The two piles belong to customers. Ronan knows the skirt, but all the white shirts look nearly the same.

Mum moves the shirt. She finds a small mark inside the neck. She checks the mark against her paper. Then she takes a button from a round tin.

“Is this a big job?” Ronan asks.

“The button is small. But I need time to find the right thread.”

She holds two lengths against the cloth. One is too bright. The other almost disappears.

Ronan brings the lamp closer. Mum asks him to stop before the cord pulls tight. He moves it back a little.

“Will you get much money?”

“Enough for this job. I told the customer the price first.”

“Even the time for the thread?”

“For the whole job.”

Ronan watches the needle go through the cloth. Then he asks about the reading activity again. Mum stops her hand.

“We still have the cost on your paper,” she says. “That has not changed. My work today is already in our plan.”

Ronan feels his face grow warm. He looks at the clothes. He thinks about Mum's pay for the shirts. He hopes it can buy another Saturday at the reading room.

“Can I help you finish faster?”

“You can put the ready clothes in the clean bag. Then you can go outside. I need room for my arms.”

He opens the bag on a clean chair. Mum checks the paper once more. He lays the clothes inside. There is plenty of room in the bag. He does not press the clothes down.

At the door, he turns back.

“Do you want your cup?”

“Yes, please.”

He brings it from the kitchen. Mum drinks. Then she points toward the yard with her chin.

“Your ball is waiting.”

The ball lies under the blue bike. Ronan pulls it out carefully. He throws it at the clear part of the wall. Once, twice, three times. On the fourth throw, it comes back into his hands.

From inside, Mum calls the number five. Ronan laughs and throws again. This time it drops. Mum does not call a number. Ronan starts his own count from one.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pile＝一叠；thread＝线；price＝价格。

## 理解问题

1. Mum为什么把衣物分成两堆？
2. Ronan帮忙后做了什么自己的事？

## 读句子

**Mum / moves / the shirt.** Mum／挪动／那件衬衫。
